promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: The intact sheet: geometry authority and edit target; change only the surface

Use case: image edit of a finished sprite sheet. Image 1 is this set's INTACT sheet and the authoritative edit target: keep EVERYTHING about its geometry exactly where it is: the same 1536x1024 canvas, the same three groups at the same positions and sizes, the same empty transparent canvas round and between them and inside the barricade ring, so that every cell of this image can replace the same cell of image 1. Keep the same materials, colours, painting finish and north-west lighting as image 1. Paint battle damage into the same pieces: on the parapet plate, chipped and spalled edges, dents and gouges, short dark cracks, scorch and soot blooms and bullet pitting, a few small loose fragments on the flat hard-standing; on the barricade ring, the same kind of hits, its pieces dented, holed and scorched; the wall tiles scuffed and pitted. Everything is still standing and complete: nothing missing, no gaps, every band still full width. Spread the damage so it looks alike on all four sides and the four corners, with no single large feature and no hard lines along cell boundaries. Material and style: an abandoned colony fortification of industrial colony steel, long derelict: riveted dark gunmetal and galvanised plate laid over a steel frame, heavy rust blooms and streaks, flaking sun-faded yellow-and-black hazard striping along the parapet top and the wall rims, dented and buckled panels, grime and rain streaks, the barricade a run of rusted steel plate barriers bolted to posts. Straight 90-degree overhead orthographic camera, no perspective. No fire, no smoke, no text, no letters, no labels, no watermark, no grid lines, no UI. Transparent background exactly where image 1 has it, plus the gaps described.
